Masuku to Rahmat Shah, out Bowled!! On a length around middle and leg, Rahmat Shah swings across the line, and gets beaten due to the inward movement. That seamed in by a long way and hit the middle pole. Quite unlike Rahmat Shah, as you don't expect him to play such rash shots. One of those rare occasions. Rahmat Shah b Masuku 7(12) [4s-1]
